response.query: What are our preregistered hypotheses, variable operationalizations, control covariates (e.g., time since treatment, cancer stage), and planned mediation/moderation tests with expected effect sizes?
response.answer: Preregistered hypotheses include the indirect effect of subjective norms on physical activity through intention strength. Control covariates include time since treatment and cancer stage. Planned mediation/moderation tests expect moderate effect sizes.
